acceptance_criteria_evidence.evidence: Approval button is strictly disabled and conflict alert is rendered when the document is marked stale or expired.
Publish authority is restricted to ADMIN and KNOWLEDGE_MANAGER roles; other roles display lack-of-authority warnings and disabled action.
Immutable provenance (sourceUri, contentHash) and quarantine alerts are prominently rendered and cannot be overridden by document contents.
All 11 unit tests pass deterministically without secrets, leaks, or external network dependencies.
